raw:
SELECT DISTINCT p.ID
FROM main."Patient" p
JOIN main."Laboratory" l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.Date >= '1997-01-01' AND l.Date <= '1997-12-31'
ORDER BY p.ID
